data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: will you choose 18, 10, or another exact catch, and is it conditional? Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At all 18, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-term. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, invite individual choices.
